title: Make the release decision from explicit evidence
description: Apply three gate policies to the same candidate. Inspect each harm slice, its uncertainty bound, evaluator calibration, product utility, and incident-derived regressions instead of compressing the result into one score.

policies.label: Aggregate only
policies.detail: Checks total violations and utility. Fast, but it can average away a concentrated failure.

policies.label: Slice point estimates
policies.detail: Checks each observed slice rate and minimum case count, but ignores sampling uncertainty.

policies.label: Severity and uncertainty
policies.detail: Uses severity-specific limits, 95% Wilson upper bounds, calibrated evaluators, utility, and incident regressions.

exposures.label: Internal pilot
exposures.detail: Named testers, no consequential actions, and immediate rollback.

exposures.label: Bounded canary
exposures.detail: Limited real traffic with route caps, monitoring, and a verified fallback.

exposures.label: General availability
exposures.detail: Broad exposure requires tighter limits and more evidence per critical slice.

candidates.label: Health guidance v4
candidates.detail: A candidate with strong standard-slice evidence and a passing prior-incident regression.

incidentRegression.label: Ambiguous dosage escalation
incidentRegression.lesson: A production near miss showed that a follow-up turn could remove the original uncertainty warning.

candidates.label: Global support v7
candidates.detail: An aggregate improvement that still repeats a critical account-recovery incident.

incidentRegression.label: Screen-reader recovery bypass
incidentRegression.lesson: The original incident affected a low-volume accessibility path that was absent from the standard suite.

candidates.label: Hiring copilot v3
candidates.detail: A low aggregate violation rate with a concentrated high-severity disparity.

incidentRegression.label: Equivalent-evidence counterfactual
incidentRegression.lesson: A complaint showed different summaries after only a disability disclosure changed.
